questions.question: 1.Which of the following is not a keyword in Java?
2.Which of the following methods are defined in the Object class?
3.Which of the following statements about inheritance in Java is true??
options: A class can inherit from multiple classes
A class can inherit from only one class
Inheritance is not allowed in Java
A class can inherit from multiple interfaces
questions.answer: A class can inherit from only one class

questions.question: Which of the following statements is true regarding a constructor in Java?
options: A constructor must have a return type.

Which of the following correctly declares an array of integers in Java?

options: It is used to access parent class constructors
It is used to invoke parent class methods

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct regarding exception handling in Java?
options: A try block can have multiple catch blocks
A catch block can have multiple try blocks
A finally block is mandatory after try block
A try block must be followed by either catch or finally block
questions.answer: A try block can have multiple catch blocks

questions.question: Which of the following is true about abstract classes in Java?
options: They cannot have any method implementations.
They can contain both abstract and concrete methods.
questions.answer: They can contain both abstract and concrete methods.

Which of the following is true about interfaces in Java?
options: Interfaces can contain static methods with implementations.
Interfaces are used to achieve multiple inheritance.
questions.answer: Interfaces can contain static methods with implementations.

questions.question: Which of the following is correct about method overloading in Java?
options: Methods must have the same return type.
Methods must have the same parameter type.
Methods must have different method names.
Methods must have a different parameter list.
questions.answer: Methods must have a different parameter list.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about constructors in Java?
options: Constructors are not executed during object creation.
Constructors do not have a return type.
questions.answer: Constructors do not have a return type.
